name: Clyde McBride
source:
Clyde McBryde, my main man! My ace in the hole! My brother from…two other fathers? Okay, I don't know where I'm going with this, but Clyde has been my best friend since we were about five years old. He can be a little anxious and obsessive-compulsive, but he's always come through for [url=https://vndb.org/c151341]me[/url]. Clyde is a little more dorky than me (which is really saying something) but he also gets better grades than I do.

Clyde loves Comic Books, Videogames, and Ghost Hunting just like I do… But he also loves Baking and Antiquing. He's the more level headed of the two of us, so I gotta say this Internet Challenge thing being his idea is a little surprising!

But, I gotta support my best friend in the ways he wants to grow, and he's been the number one cheerleader for me getting with Ronnie Anne! Clyde is adopted, he has two Dads instead of a Mom! But because of that, he understands family can be more than blood, and he's practically a Loud himself with how much he hangs out with us.

Clyde and I even have our own friendship title, ‘Clincoln McCloud'! I always know I can take on anything when Clyde has my back!

[In game description]
